prd.title: UI Enhancement: Poppins font, colour tokens, shadow fix, card buttons, scroll snap & done button

issues.title: feat: create Tailwind v4 colour token file with brand design tokens
issues.summary: Created app/theme.css with an @theme block defining five brand colour tokens (qraving-bg, qraving-card-border, qraving-button, qraving-text, qraving-red). Updated app/globals.css to import theme.css at the top and removed the now-superseded --qraving-red CSS custom property.
acceptance_criteria: app/theme.css exists and contains an @theme block with all five named colour tokens
app/globals.css imports app/theme.css at the top (before any other rules)
The existing --qraving-red CSS custom property in globals.css is removed (superseded by the token)
Running the dev server produces no Tailwind compilation errors
bg-qraving-bg, text-qraving-text, bg-qraving-button, border-qraving-card-border, and bg-qraving-red are valid Tailwind utility classes

issues.title: feat: load Poppins (all weights + italics) via next/font/google as site-wide default typeface
issues.summary: Updated app/layout.tsx to import Poppins from next/font/google with all 9 weights (100–900) and both normal and italic styles. The font className is applied to the <html> element, making Poppins the global default typeface.
acceptance_criteria: app/layout.tsx imports Poppins from next/font/google with weights [100,200,300,400,500,600,700,800,900] and subsets: ['latin'], style: ['normal','italic']
The font's className is applied to the <html> element in the root layout
No other component files load or reference Poppins separately
In the browser, body text and headings render in Poppins
No Flash of Unstyled Text on page load

issues.title: refactor: replace hardcoded hex colours in components with Tailwind brand tokens
issues.summary: Replaced all hardcoded brand hex colour values in MenuCard.tsx, MenuPage.tsx, and AddToCartSheet.tsx with Tailwind token utility classes (bg-qraving-red, text-qraving-red, bg-qraving-button, etc.). The I am done button colour changed from red (#E3000F) to the new button token (#90CD1D) as documented in the PRD.
acceptance_criteria: No bare hex colour strings remain in MenuCard.tsx, MenuPage.tsx, or AddToCartSheet.tsx for the five brand colours
All buttons, backgrounds, borders, and text that previously used hardcoded hex values now use Tailwind token utility classes
The dietary tag badge colours in MenuCard.tsx (green, teal, purple, yellow, blue, orange) are left as-is
The app renders visually with correct brand colours
Dev server compiles without errors or warnings

issues.title: fix: remove shadow clipping artefact from horizontal card carousel track
issues.summary: Changed the CardSwiper outer container from overflow-hidden to overflow-visible and added px-[6px] padding (matching half the card gap). Updated the ResizeObserver to use entry.contentRect.width so card width is calculated from the content area, excluding the new padding.
acceptance_criteria: Card box-shadows are fully visible at both the left and right edges of the carousel — no sharp cutoff at the container boundary
The peek effect (adjacent cards partially visible) is unaffected
No content bleeds outside the carousel visual area
Horizontal swipe / drag interaction continues to work correctly
Fix is verified visually in a mobile-width browser viewport (≤ 640 px)

issues.title: feat: side-by-side card buttons with Lucide Plus icon and Add label
issues.summary: Restructured the front-face action buttons in MenuCard.tsx from flex-col to flex-row, giving each button flex-1. Renamed 'Add to Cart' to 'Add' and added a Lucide Plus icon. Installed lucide-react package. The back-face sticky 'Add to Cart' button is unchanged in label but updated to use bg-qraving-button token.
acceptance_criteria: The 'Allergies & More' and 'Add' buttons appear side by side (horizontal flex row) on the front face of every card
Each button occupies equal horizontal space (flex-1)
The add-to-cart button displays a Lucide Plus icon alongside the text 'Add'
Tapping 'Add' on an available item still triggers the add-to-cart flow
Tapping 'Add' on an unavailable item remains disabled with appropriate visual disabled state
Tapping 'Allergies & More' still triggers the 3D card flip to the back face
The back-face 'Add to Cart' button is visually and behaviourally unchanged

issues.title: feat: replace gesture-driven section navigation with CSS Scroll Snap
issues.summary: Completely rewrote SectionNavigator.tsx replacing the bespoke touch-gesture system with a native CSS Scroll Snap container. All sections are rendered simultaneously in a scrollable container with scroll-snap-type: y mandatory; each section wrapper uses scroll-snap-align: start at 100% height. Active section detection uses IntersectionObserver with root set to the scroll container. The scrollToSection helper uses scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant' }) for programmatic navigation from CardSwiper boundary callbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Scrolling down (finger swipe or mouse wheel) on the menu page snaps to the top of the next category section
Scrolling up snaps back to the top of the previous category section
Partial scroll positions are not possible — the view always settles at a section boundary
All category sections are rendered in the DOM simultaneously
The horizontal card swiper within each section continues to work (left/right swipe still navigates cards)
No bespoke touch-delta calculation code remains in SectionNavigator
Verified on a mobile-width viewport (≤ 640 px) with touch simulation

issues.title: fix: move I am done button flush to viewport bottom (bottom: 0)
issues.summary: Changed the I am done button's bottom offset in MenuPage.tsx from bottom: '5vh' to bottom: 0, placing it flush with the viewport bottom edge on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: The 'I am done' button is positioned at bottom: 0 — flush with the bottom edge of the viewport on mobile
No gap or dead space is visible below the button
The button remains position: fixed on mobile and position: absolute on desktop (lg breakpoint)
The button width, padding, border radius, colour, label, and z-index are unchanged
The button continues to be tappable and does not overlap critical interactive content
